direction: Daily long-only fast/slow recursive EMA trend-state crossover, tested separately on BTC and ETH.
hypothesis: A faster recursive trend state above a slower one may keep the spot account invested during persistent advances and move it to cash after trend deterioration. This is a deterministic, fixed-rule stress test, not a claim of an edge. Prior 15m EMA-cross results were strongly negative; daily spans and a complete predeclared surface test a slower horizon without selecting from this OOS.

literature_context.citation: Technical trading rules in the cryptocurrency market (2019), daily simple moving-average rules on 11 cryptocurrencies, 2016–2018.
literature_context.scope: Motivates a daily trend-rule falsification test; not evidence for this EMA rule or modern OOS profitability.

literature_context.scope: Motivates full cost testing; not a rule replication.

data.market: Binance spot archived 1m OHLCV aggregated into continuous UTC daily closes; historical execution reference is next-day 00:01 1m open.

portfolio.weight_semantics: 100% single-asset sleeve for the named asset; BTC and ETH are separate configurations, not a combined portfolio.

rule.indicator: Recursive EMA: alpha=2/(span+1), seed EMA[0]=the first completed UTC daily close, EMA[j]=alpha*close[j]+(1-alpha)*EMA[j-1], Python float adjust=False, initialized once from the first archived daily close and never reset at folds.
rule.entry: At the close of a fully completed UTC daily bar j, if EMA_fast[j] is strictly greater than EMA_slow[j] and the account is flat, set desired-long. Equality preserves previous desired state.
rule.exit: At the close of a fully completed UTC daily bar j, if EMA_fast[j] is strictly below EMA_slow[j] while long, set desired-cash. Equality preserves prior desired. No stop, target, confirmation counter, cooldown, overlap or scale-in.
rule.timing: The daily close is available at the next UTC 00:00; execute at the following UTC 00:01 one-minute open, exactly 60 seconds later. That historical open is only a historical-backtest reference. Warmup establishes indicators but produces no pre-OOS trade.
rule.account: One separate 2,000-USDT long-only spot account per asset/span configuration. The raw weight is 100% of that account to the named single asset when long. Full affordable LOT_SIZE-floored amount is bought, all units are sold at exit. No leverage, shorting, borrowing, transfer, yield, cross-asset rebalancing or shared impact.
rule.terminal: Liquidate any position at the declared common terminal UTC 00:01 reference with full modeled costs.

cost_model.impact_model: 0.5 * sample standard deviation(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / mean quote volume(previous 20 complete UTC days))
cost_model.historical_l2: unavailable; spread, slippage and immediate fill are modeled assumptions
cost_model.funding_borrow: Not applicable to unlevered long-only spot.

walk_forward.purge_embargo: No model fitting or forward labels; deterministic signal uses only closed bars. Warmup is strictly prior data.
walk_forward.holdout_disclosure: Repeated repository development/OOS history, not an untouched final holdout.
